data.one_liner: Pre‑built Flutter widgets for displaying Firebase Realtime Database data.
data.what_it_does: Provides ready‑made widgets that bind to Firebase Realtime Database queries and update automatically as data changes. Includes utilities for pagination, sorting, and handling empty states.
use_when: You need quick UI for realtime lists or grids without writing stream handling code
You want a consistent look and feel across Android, iOS, Web, and desktop
avoid_when: You require highly custom UI beyond what the provided widgets expose
You are not using Firebase Realtime Database
strengths: Works on all major Flutter platforms
Keeps UI in sync with database automatically
weaknesses: Limited customization compared to hand‑rolled widgets
Tied to Firebase Realtime Database API
data.setup_notes: Add firebase_core and firebase_database to your project and initialize Firebase as usual; no code‑gen required.

alternatives.name: realtime_client
alternatives.why_pick_it: A lower‑level client for Realtime Database that lets you build custom UI without the pre‑built widgets
